data.title: Aerodrome and Velodrome merge to launch Aero across seven blockchain networks
data.summary_raw: Aerodrome and Velodrome have merged to launch Aero across Ethereum mainnet, Base, Robinhood Chain, Ink, OP Mainnet, Arc, and Arbitrum.

data.title: Robinhood single-stock perps could be a ‘strong positive’ for HOOD shares, Mizuho says
data.summary_raw: A Mizuho survey of 600+ Robinhood users finds 94% would trade single-stock perpetual futures, mostly with new money.

data.title: American Bankers Association accuses OCC of undermining Congress with final stablecoin rewards rule
data.summary_raw: The fight between banks and crypto has reignited after a top banking regulator declined to weigh in on third-party stablecoin rewards.

data.title: Dataline raises $10.6 million for decentralized data network for AI agents, plans ICO
data.summary_raw: The startup also plans to hold a public token sale through Uniswap's auction platform, with details expected next week.
